info.name: Sunrise ATA-IDE with the m6 kernel ROM
info.description: ATA-IDE interface with the m6 kernel ROM (build/m6-sunriseide.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness; no checksum, the ROM changes with every build) and one hard disk, the image given with -hda. No slave: openMSX's stock extension declares one and creates a 100 MB image for it on every run.
